thread:
claire: Quick design review: prompt-sets regression list UX. Focused on selection behavior, bulk-approve copy, and empty-state affordances. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE-promptsets

hamid: My main worry is the bulk-approve CTA label. Current: 'Approve changes'  ambig for new users. Suggest 'Approve selected diffs'.

jess: Agreed. Also UX: when a user selects items and then filters, selection persists but the banner disappears. Users think selection cleared. Can we persist banner with count + a subtle toast?

rafa: For keyboard accessibility: Shift+Arrow should extend selection; space toggles item. Need to document and add tooltip. Also when banner appears don't steal focus.

a11ybot: Contrast check: banner CTA uses #9CA3AF on disabled bg  contrast 2.6:1 fail. Recommend #374151 or increase weight. Also recommend aria-live='polite' for selection count updates.

claire: Good catches. Decision proposals: 1) copy -> 'Approve selected diffs' + subline 'Only affects selected items'; 2) persist banner during filtering but collapse to summary '3 selected' with 'Show' button; 3) keyboard: implement Shift+Arrow and Space, document in tooltip; 4) fix CTA contrast per a11ybot.

hamid: On the persistence: when filter hides selected items show a small pill 'X selected (hidden)' that expands to list. Avoid surprise.

jess: Microcopy for empty regression state: 'No regressions found. Run more tests or adjust prompts.' Keep short.
afa: I'll implement keyboard handlers + a11y attributes. Plan to PR tomorrow.

a11ybot: Also ensure checkboxes have aria-checked and list uses role='list' + role='listitem' for assistive tech.

claire: Action items: jess update copy & empty-state text; hamid add pill mock and toast behavior; rafa implement keyboard + aria; design to confirm CTA color. Quick review Friday 10am PT. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
